ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values; predominantly black with localized high-intensity white clusters at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the visible surface expanse; distinct white circular clusters mapped to the left leading edge and both distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertex base is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; the right lobe displays prominent, high-amplitude triangular peaks; the left lobe displays more frequent, lower-amplitude scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep transitioning to an abrupt upward inflection at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels concentrated on the superior tips of both lobes and the left outer margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular trailing edge topography suggesting cumulative tissue loss; prominent biological encrustations (barnacles) localized at the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged 'saw-tooth' profile on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe trailing edge.
